text_block_list.text:
On this day, I went with Sakura Laurel to 
have her legs examined.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
How many seasons and how much time have 
passed since I first came to the hospital 
with you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It felt long, but it went by so fast.
It felt long, but it went by so fast.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But I believe you will still have to 
keep me company for a while longer.
choice_data_list:
That just means the fun is saved for 
later.

That just means the fun is saved for 
later.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Let's chase after our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—No abnormalities were found. There 
shouldn't be any issues with racing from 
now on.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The issue with your legs has been 
resolved. You're completely fine to run to 
your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: It's not... a lie...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Is that... really true...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is the fruit of your collective 
dedication to her treatment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer. Um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Um, I... I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I want to run...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaale...

Sakura Laurel continues stretching 
thoroughly. ...Her preparations are 
complete.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I'm heading out.
choice_data_list: Yeah... Go give it everything you've got!!
Yeah... Give it everything you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(They told me there's no issue anymore, 
...but honestly, I still can't tell the 
difference.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(But if I really can run on these legs... 
If it's okay for me to run...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
("That very step" that nearly broke my 
legs before—this time, with everything 
I've got—!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

And Sakura Laurel ran one lap, two laps, 
three laps, as if releasing all the 
feelings she had been holding back—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haaah... haaah... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I ran on these legs...! On my 
very own legs, with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm able... to run again...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes...! ...Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Trainer... you really are a crybaby, 
aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu...... Is that... really so...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: No way... ...Ngh, ......ngh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...!

And Sakura Laurel wept, large tears 
streaming down her face.

Her nose bright red like a child's. Her 
face crumpled up... beaming with joy.

Paying no mind to the people around them, 
they shared their joy at the top of their 
lungs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. Do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Earlier than scheduled... I want to go 
herald the arrival of 'spring.'"
choice_data_list: You mean the Tenno Sho (Spring), right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. And that's where I'll go challenge 
her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —With these legs.
choice_data_list: Okay, but let's go get fired up first!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: To boost morale?

Rather than jumping straight into the 
Tenno Sho (Spring), I wanted Sakura Laurel 
to run another race first to build up 
momentum.

Next year will surely be an important 
year. In that case, I want to make its 
first race a brilliant victory.
choice_data_list: How about entering the Nakayama Kimpai?
How about entering the Nakayama Kimpai?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If I remember correctly, the Gold 
Cup is a race held at the beginning of the 
year, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
An auspicious race, was it? Winning it 
seems like it would make for a great start 
to the year♪
choice_data_list:
Right, let's take 1st place as a get-well 
celebration!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It certainly is perfect for a 
celebration!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...And from there, it will begin anew, 
won't it? The story of 'me.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I always thought 'someday' this 
day would come. But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the starting line for 
"Sakura Laurel" is finally here.
choice_data_list: Let's definitely make our dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes, ...without fail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(—This is surely a special story. The 
"present" that I finally fought for and 
won.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(A future we won... precisely because it 
was us.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer, let us celebrate properly. 
With a victory in the Nakayama Kimpai—)
